newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures stuck slightly lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures stuck slightly lower.

text.p: May 5 - IMM currency futures stuck at slightly lower levels in extremely quiet, holiday-thinned trading. Floor brokers said price boards estimated volume in June marks at only 6,000 contracts. Earlier, they said June marks test support near $0.5786 but lacked extension. German April jobless data Tuesday; UK monetary meeting, US Fed's Beige Book Wednesday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
